The variable whose effect on BA degree completion decreases from 0.3636 to -0.2293 (while becoming insignificant) when both race and academic characteristics are included in the analysis is **SES** (Socioeconomic Status).

**अंतिम निष्कर्ष व परिकल्पना (Natural-Language Hypothesis):**
जब विश्लेषण में जाति (`SAMPLE_RACE`) और शैक्षणिक प्रदर्शन विशेषताओं (ASVAB टेस्ट स्कोर कंपोजिट और कक्षा में पर्सेंटाइल रैंक) दोनों को नियंत्रित किया जाता है, तो बीए डिग्री पूर्णता (`BA DEGREE COMPLETED`) पर सामाजिक-आर्थिक स्थिति (**SES**) का प्रभाव सकारात्मक (लगभग 0.3636) से घटकर नकारात्मक (-0.2293) हो जाता है और इसका प्रारंभिक प्रभाव शैक्षणिक कारकों द्वारा अवशोषित (mediated) हो जाता है।

payload.hypothesis: The effect of SES (socioeconomic status) on BA degree completion decreases from 0.3636 to -0.2293 (while becoming insignificant) when both race and academic characteristics (standardized ability test scores and high school class rank) are included in the regression analysis.
payload.workflow:
1. Loaded and inspected nls_ses_processed.csv (8,773 observations, 9 variables).
2. Formulated baseline Logit models without academic variables to observe social background effects.
3. Formulated full Logit models incorporating race and academic characteristics (ABILITY composite and PERCENTILE IN CLASS).
4. Compared coefficient shifts across all candidate variables (SES, SAMPLE_SEX, FAMILY SIZE OF SAMPLE).
5. Confirmed SES uniquely exhibits the specified coefficient decline from positive (~0.36) to negative (~-0.23).
